description: Local-first desktop companion connecting Android phones and Windows PCs for notifications, messages, calls, clipboard, file transfers, screen mirroring, phone apps, and media controls.
notes: Review status (2026-11-06): the official v0.1.4 Windows x64 installer and SHA-256 below are verified. v0.1.5 is now the latest stable release and adds Windows ARM64; its release asset checksum has not yet been independently verified here, so this manifest retains the last verified v0.1.4 artifact.

The Windows download is an NSIS setup executable, not a portable build. The upstream setup first unpacks files to a temporary directory to launch its custom setup UI, then performs a machine-wide installation.

The NSIS installer changes ACLs on new install directories with icacls, adds Windows Firewall rules, creates a scheduled update task, registers an AppX sparse package, writes HKLM install/uninstall metadata, and creates Start Menu/Desktop shortcuts. NectarLink also has its own updater.

Passing Scoop's $dir with /D is unsafe: the installer can lock the target directory ACL and prevent Scoop's normal update/uninstall operations. Extracting the NSIS payload without running setup would bypass the vendor's supported setup and cleanup routines and is not an officially published portable build.

Keep this manifest under review. Do not promote it to bucket/ until upstream provides a Windows portable archive or a supported Scoop-compatible installation mode with a user-writable install directory, controlled update behavior, and a tested uninstall routine.
